title: Never Ending Cairo Market
description: Revitalizing a historic Cairo market through computational form-finding, with a redesigned circulation and a parametric roof system based on the Cairo pattern.
body: The project explores how computational methods can manage complex geometries and shape new ways of experiencing space. The Bab al-Luq market is reorganized as a multi-level shopping environment driven by circulation layout.

Differential growth principles, settled through dynamic relaxation in Kangaroo, generate smooth, fluid pathways connecting the primary entrances, with two paths displacing into ramps with storage beneath. The roof follows the same flows: a heat map sets its frame sizing and deformation, and the parametric Cairo tessellation its modules.

The result is an organic network of routes and ramps that invites exploration rather than a single pass through, under a roof that turns the initial flat surface into a highly expressive structure whose openings cast light and shadow strategically aligned with the movement beneath.

sections.title: Design Concept
body: Two computational principles carry the whole scheme. Differential growth generates the circulation and drives the roof; the traditional Cairo tessellation, reconstructed parametrically, defines the roof modules.

sections.title: Computational Design Methodology
body: Circulation lines connect the building's four entrances, relaxed in Kangaroo into smooth polylines, then offset into market paths. Two paths rise into ramps linking both floors.

sections.title: Form Iterations
body: Varying length and radius parameters explores different curve amplitudes and frequencies, yielding paths that fluidly avoid the existing structure.

sections.title: Form Finding Process
body: Seven steps take the roof from a flat surface to its final form: the Cairo tessellation is applied, frame sizes varied, and points displaced in Z — then the circulation heat map drives both the frame sizing and the point movement, so the openings above line up with the flows beneath.

sections.title: Exploded View
body: The intervention separated into its three layers — the new roof carrying the Cairo tessellation, the support structure beneath it, and the existing 1912 market it sits over.

sections.title: Drawings
body: Plans, sections and views of the finished scheme: two levels tied by the ramps, under one continuous roof over the existing market.
